description: This file contains a series of shell script tests for Git repository operations, specifically focusing on push options, hooks, and configuration settings related to a Git server, with custom hooks and push behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, wrapping the test commands.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or restores a Git hook (likely custom test function).

methods.name: test-tool
methods.description: A helper for testing outputs, probably a custom utility.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output to verify behavior.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares the references of a Git repository against expected values.
